## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The Commands section of AGENTS.md still tells contributors to run `make test`, a target this pull request removes, so that line needs updating before the guide is accurate again.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README's instruction to match. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists each repository file and the Makefile targets.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update AGENTS.md Commands to `make check` — After this rename, anyone who follows the unchanged AGENTS.md:24 ("Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite.") gets `make: *** No rule to make target 'test'` because the Makefile now defines only `check` and `lint`. The new Layout line at AGENTS.md:10 says "`Makefile` defines the `check` and `lint` targets", so the guide now contradicts itself. — AGENTS.md:26 says the repository has no CI, so contributors and agents following the guide lose the only documented pre-push test step.
